"FU got a good start, and they got control over high rl/quad.. We really didn't come in 2 the game..we tried.. but it was one man trying to save the day.. FU played as a team.. we didn't. What more to say then.. today FU was the better dm2 team. GG FU! / [E]Hixen"
=== E1M2 === E: 271 - FU: 77
[[Image:E-fu-e1m2.jpg|320px]]

Demos: [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/c/c9/E-fu_e1m2-goljat.qwd Goljat (E)] | [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/b/b2/E-fu-e1m2-trinidy.qwd trinidy (E)]

"We had lost the first round.. so we needed to win this one.. so I switched with Pingvin, which maybe I should have done at dm2.. anyway.. they got the good start again, but we managed to hold them back with excellent teamplay. and ohhh man. I must say.. I can't be fun for FU playing vs Pingvin.. he camped gl without rl and gl.. he just used ssg from time to time.. and he held it really well. and the other players from E also played really good.. and + to FU - L that made some nice comebacks into the game with some nice quadtaking. But when L couldn't get quad.. trinidy did.. and he had fun with it :) / [E]Hixen"
=== DM3 === E: 208 - FU: 55
[[Image:E-fu-dm3.jpg|320px]]

Demos: [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/9/9a/E-fu-dm3-trinidy.qwd trinidy (E)]

"Phew..we managed to win e1m2.. so it was a last round at dm3.. played with the same lineup as the e1m2 game. They got the good start again.. but Goljat got the rl.. and went to ra and managed to get the first ra and the second quad and could secure the most important positions. But then sometime into the game.. I think it was after the first penta.. Timi got quad and totally cleaned out ra/sng.. but then again..we managed to get the quad after that and clean the out the house again.. and from that.. it was happy fragging.. Thx Fu for a great game.. and good luck in the future! / [E]Hixen"
